title: Invert4TVG: A Temporal Video Grounding Framework with Inversion Tasks Preserving Action Understanding Ability
abstract: arXiv:2508.07388v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Temporal Video Grounding (TVG) aims to localize video segments corresponding to a given textual query, which often describes human actions. However, we observe that current methods, usually optimizing for high temporal Intersection-over-Union (IoU), frequently struggle to accurately recognize or understand the underlying actions in both the video and query, thus reducing the effectiveness of these methods. To address this, we propose a novel TVG framework that integrates inversion-based TVG as auxiliary objectives to maintain the model's action understanding ability. We introduce three kinds of inversion TVG tasks derived from the original TVG annotations: (1) Verb Completion, predicting masked verbs (actions) in queries given video segments; (2) Action Recognition, identifying query-described actions; and (3) Video Description, generating descriptions containing query-relevant actions given video segments. translated_title: Invert4TVG：一种通过反转任务保持动作理解能力的时序视频定位框架
translated_abstract: 时序视频定位旨在定位与给定文本查询相对应的视频片段，而这些查询通常描述的是人类动作。然而，我们观察到，当前方法通常以高时序交并比（IoU）为优化目标，常常难以准确识别或理解视频和查询中蕴含的动作，从而降低了这些方法的有效性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的TVG框架，该框架将基于反转的TVG作为辅助目标进行整合，以保持模型的动作理解能力。我们引入了三种源自原始TVG标注的反转TVG任务：(1) 动词补全，在给定视频片段的情况下预测查询中被遮蔽的动词（动作）；(2) 动作识别，识别查询所描述的动作；(3) 视频描述，在给定视频片段的情况下生成包含与查询相关动作的描述。这些反转任务……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Invert4TVG框架，通过引入动词补全、动作识别和视频描述三种反转任务作为辅助目标，在提升时序视频定位性能的同时保持模型对动作的理解能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Invert4TVG, a temporal video grounding framework that integrates three inversion tasks—verb completion, action recognition, and video description—as auxiliary objectives to preserve the model's action understanding ability while improving grounding performance.
